nativeCapabilities.subagents: available in current local releases when requested or required by AGENTS.md/skills
nativeCapabilities.worktrees: native in the ChatGPT desktop app; availability differs by surface
nativeCapabilities.approvals: sandbox and approval policy are inherited by subagents
nativeCapabilities.resume: agent threads and app tasks are inspectable; persisted run files remain the portable source of truth

dispatchGuidance: Use native subagents for bounded independent work when the current Codex surface exposes delegation tools.
Keep read-heavy exploration and independent review in separate agent threads when useful.
Use a worktree only when the current Codex surface actually supports it; otherwise serialize writers or use disjoint write scopes.
Do not change sandbox or approval settings on behalf of a child agent.
If native delegation is unavailable, return or use the rendered prompt as a separate-task handoff.
limitations: Subagents add token and startup cost.
Non-interactive work cannot satisfy a new approval prompt.
Project custom-agent authoring formats may evolve.
